description: Add or remove MSSQL databases from a remote host.

parameters.name: autocommit
parameters.description: Automatically commit the change only if the import succeed. Sometimes it is necessary to use autocommit=true, since some content can not be changed within a transaction. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: login_password
parameters.description: The password used to authenticate with. Default: ""

parameters.name: login_port
parameters.description: Port of the MSSQL server. Requires login_host be defined as other than localhost if login_port is used. Default: "1433"

parameters.name: login_user
parameters.description: The username used to authenticate with. Default: ""

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the database to add or remove.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Location, on the remote host, of the dump file to read from or write to. Uncompressed SQL files (.sql) files are supported.

examples:
- name: Create a new database with name 'jackdata'
  community.general.mssql_db:
    name: jackdata
    state: present

# Copy database dump file to remote host and restore it to database 'my_db'
- name: Copy database dump file to remote host
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: dump.sql
    dest: /tmp

- name: Restore the dump file to database 'my_db'
  community.general.mssql_db:
    name: my_db
    state: import
    target: /tmp/dump.sql
